bio: I am Dr. Nayyar Ahmed Khan, Faculty of Computer Science at Shaqra University. My research brings AI and machine learning together with healthcare informatics, blockchain, and secure distributed systems. My publication record includes federated learning for heart-disease detection, blockchain-enabled medical IoT, secure collaborative drug discovery, explainable AI for structure-based drug design, and AI-based COVID-19 advisory applications. With a Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering and a foundation in network security, cloud computing, and intrusion detection, I approach healthcare technology through the complementary lenses of intelligent analysis, privacy, and digital trust. Alongside research, I teach computer science, support technology academy initiatives, and mentor student projects. My healthcare work is presented as computational research and technology development; clinical effectiveness requires separate validation.
